sections.Intro: This remedy is characterized by its marked action on the mucous membranes of the nose and eyes. It is especially indicated in cases of hay-fever and common cold. There is a general feeling of irritation and burning. The characteristic symptom is a profuse, watery nasal discharge and a profuse lacrimation.
sections.Eyes: Profuse lacrimation. Eyes red and burning. Itching of the eyelids.
sections.Nose: Profuse, watery nasal discharge. Sneezing. Stuffed feeling in the nose. Nosebleed.
sections.Throat: Irritation and rawness in the throat. Hawking of mucus. Cough.
sections.Respiratory: Shortness of breath. Wheezing. Violent cough, with a sensation of oppression in the chest.
sections.Abdomen: Distended and tender. Flatulence. Chronic diarrhoea.
